groups.operation: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start in supported Markdown.
groups.condition: The tag has a non-ASCII attribute value.
groups.capability: scan_html_block_start_7 must return a usable result to open_new_blocks.
groups.consequence: The type 7 HTML block start is missed.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the same non-ASCII attribute recognition hypothesis without specifying whether the bytes are valid UTF-8.

groups.operation: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start.
groups.condition: A quoted tag attribute contains an invalid high byte, such as 0xFF, with UTF-8 validation disabled.
groups.capability: _scan_html_block_start_7 must accept the byte, and _scan_at must deliver its result to the block parser without CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8 changing the input.
groups.consequence: The HTML block is not opened.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both target recognition of a type 7 tag containing an invalid high byte; 0xFF is the concrete byte used by one candidate.

groups.operation: Recognize a type 7 HTML block start.
groups.condition: The tag attribute contains a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 value.
groups.capability: scan_html_block_start_7 must accept the value and let the block parser open the HTML block.
groups.consequence: The valid UTF-8 tag is not recognized as an HTML block start.
groups.equivalence_reason: Its valid UTF-8 condition is more specific than the unspecified non-ASCII condition and distinct from an invalid high byte.
